# ISuperstateArkErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/arks/ISuperstateArkErrors.sol)

**Title:**
ISuperstateArkErrors

Custom errors raised by Superstate Ark contracts


## Errors
### InvalidShareTokenAddress
Thrown when the Superstate fund share token address supplied to the constructor is
the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidShareTokenAddress();
```

### InvalidOracleAddress
Thrown when the price oracle address is the zero address, or (for the Subscribe ark)
when it does not match `SUPERSTATE_SUBSCRIBE.superstateOracle()`.


```solidity
error InvalidOracleAddress();
```

### InvalidRedeemAddress
Thrown when the Superstate redeem (RedemptionIdle) contract address supplied to the
constructor is the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidRedeemAddress();
```

### OraclePriceNotPositive
Thrown when the oracle returns a non-positive answer (`answer <= 0`), which cannot be
used to price shares against the base asset.


```solidity
error OraclePriceNotPositive();
```

### StaleOraclePrice
Thrown when the oracle's last update is older than `ORACLE_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT` (24h),
so the reported price is considered stale and unsafe for conversion.


```solidity
error StaleOraclePrice();
```

### InvalidSweepSlippage
Thrown when a new sweep slippage exceeds `MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE` (0.5%).


```solidity
error InvalidSweepSlippage(Percentage newSlippage, Percentage maxSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newSlippage`|`Percentage`|The rejected slippage value.|
|`maxSlippage`|`Percentage`|The maximum permitted sweep slippage.|

### InvalidDepositSlippage
Thrown when a new deposit slippage exceeds `MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE` (0.5%).


```solidity
error InvalidDepositSlippage(Percentage newSlippage, Percentage maxSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newSlippage`|`Percentage`|The rejected slippage value.|
|`maxSlippage`|`Percentage`|The maximum permitted deposit slippage.|

### SharesNotArrived
Thrown when the share-balance delta after a subscription/clear is below the
oracle-implied expected shares minus `depositSlippage` — i.e. Superstate delivered
fewer fund tokens than expected (fee enabled, partial mint, etc.).


```solidity
error SharesNotArrived(uint256 expectedShares, uint256 actualNewShares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`expectedShares`|`uint256`|The oracle-implied shares expected for the deposited amount.|
|`actualNewShares`|`uint256`|The shares that actually arrived since the pre-call snapshot.|

### InsufficientAssetsReturned
Thrown by `sweep` when the returned USDC, valued in shares at the current oracle
price, falls below `pendingWithdrawalShares` minus `sweepSlippage` — i.e. the
settlement returned less than the outstanding redemption was worth.


```solidity
error InsufficientAssetsReturned(uint256 receivedAssets, uint256 expectedShares, uint256 receivedShares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receivedAssets`|`uint256`|The base-asset (USDC) amount held by the ark at sweep time.|
|`expectedShares`|`uint256`|The outstanding `pendingWithdrawalShares` being settled.|
|`receivedShares`|`uint256`|`receivedAssets` valued in shares at the current oracle price.|

### PendingWithdrawalActive
Thrown when `requestWithdrawal` is called while a withdrawal cycle is already in
flight (`pendingWithdrawalShares > 0`). Prevents stacking redemptions that the
single-tranche `sweep` slippage check cannot reconcile.


```solidity
error PendingWithdrawalActive();
```
